messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and for a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a thorough cleaning (strings, fretboard, body). Tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take High‑Quality Photos** | Capture the whole body, headstock, strings, fretboard, and any imperfections. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local classifieds. Note price ranges for similar models, ages, and conditions. | Helps you set a realistic asking price and avoid underselling. | | **4. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, wood type, finish, any upgrades, and a brief history. Mention any wear or repairs. | Transparency builds trust and reduces back‑and‑forth questions. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, global reach.
• **eBay** – auction or fixed price, large audience.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no shipping hassles.
• **Local music stores** – consignment or direct sale. | Different platforms reach different buyer types; use a mix if you’re not in a hurry. | | **6. Set a Competitive Price** | Start slightly above your target to allow room for negotiation. Consider adding a “non‑negotiable” tag if you’re firm. | Buyers often expect to haggle; a higher starting point can still land you a good deal. | | **7. Decide on Shipping vs. Local Pickup** | • **Local pickup**: safer, no shipping cost.
• **Shipping**: use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with insurance and tracking. | Shipping expands your buyer pool but adds cost and risk. | | **8. Prepare for Negotiation** | Be ready to answer questions, show photos, and possibly offer a small discount for quick sale. | Good negotiation skills can close the deal faster and at a better price. | | **9. Meet Safely (if local)** | Arrange a public place, bring a friend, and ask for a photo ID. Bring a friend or family member if possible. | Safety first—never meet strangers alone. | | **10. Finalize the Sale** | Use a secure payment method (cash, Venmo, PayPal Goods & Services, or a bank transfer). Sign a simple bill of sale that includes serial number, condition, and date. | Protects both parties and provides a record of the transaction. | | **11. Handle Taxes & Record Keeping** | If you’re a hobbyist selling a single instrument, you likely won’t owe taxes. Keep the receipt and sale details in case you need them later. | Good practice for future reference. | ### Quick Tips - **Bundle Extras**: Offer a strap, case, or extra strings for free or at a small discount—adds perceived value. - **Highlight Unique Features**: If your guitar has a special finish, custom inlay, or vintage appeal, emphasize it. - **Use Video**: A short video of you playing the guitar can showcase tone and playability. - **Respond Promptly**: Buyers appreciate quick replies; it speeds up the process. - **Be Honest About Condition**: Over‑promising can lead to returns or bad reviews. ### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2015 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand: Yamaha - Model: FG800 - Year: 2015 - Wood: Spruce top, Nato back & sides - Finish: Natural - Serial #: 12345678 - Condition: Light play marks on the back, no cracks, fully functional - Extras: New set of strings, strap, and a protective case Price: $350 (Negotiable) Photos: [Attach 8–10 high‑resolution images] Video: [Link to a 30‑second clip of you playing] Shipping: Free shipping within the U.S. (insured, tracked) ``` Feel free to adapt the template to your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with the sale! If you need help with pricing or setting up a listing on a particular platform, just let me know.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We can give steps: research market value, clean instrument, take photos, list on platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Reverb, local classifieds), set price, describe condition, shipping options, safety tips. Also mention potential appraisal, trade-in, consignment. Provide tips for negotiation, safe meeting. Also mention taxes. No function call needed.
